body.name: Exact deterministic linear-band width frontier
body.construction:
On fixed inputs satisfying \texttt{ass:treated-set-nonempty}, for
\(s\in\{\mathrm{nested},\mathrm{deep}\}\), define
\[
 W_s=\inf_{w\in\mathcal F_s,\,\ell\in[0,\infty)^M}
 \max_{e\in\mathcal E}\ell_e
\]
subject to
\[
 \inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,K,p}}
 P\{ |\widehat\tau_e(w)-\tau_e|\leq\ell_e
       \text{ for every }e\in\mathcal E\}\geq1-\alpha,
\]
where \(w\) and \(\ell\) are functions only of the fixed design and model
inputs.
